normative_inheritance: All v3 source/hash bindings, primary Holm/raw-p/Bonferroni rules, intersection-union NI rules, PCG64 matrices, margins, model-state digest, complete-target single-test reuse, host MaxRSS/original walltime gates, no-training rule and no-posthoc-substitute rule remain normative except where v4 explicitly replaces aggregation, materialization, replay lifecycle, receipt, or feasibility language.

path_security.runtime_closure: A separate exact future runtime manifest must enumerate every interpreter, shared library, CUDA library, Python module and system file opened outside the three scientific input roots, with absolute path/dev/inode/owner/mode/length/SHA. These files are read-only runtime dependencies, may contain no project data, and are not wildcard-authorized by a broad root.
path_security.input_policy: Every input root and component resolves to the literal listed absolute path; every opened input is regular, nonsymlink, owner UID 12184, opened O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, mode unchanged, and included in a before/after byte manifest. No input may be opened writable.
path_security.output_policy: Output root and canonical claim must both be absent. Create a parent-directory-fsynced O_CREAT|O_EXCL claim before mkdir; create only beneath the claimed root with O_NOFOLLOW, full-write loops, file fsync and parent fsync. No overwrite, retry root or alternate path.
path_security.no_alias: Resolved output root is outside and not ancestor/descendant of every input root. Reject equal (st_dev,st_ino) between any input and output/claim file, input hardlink count changes, bind mounts, symlink components, mount crossing not prebound by contract, and any output path resolving into an input root.
path_security.read_only_verification: Hash and stat every authorized input before parent page-touch and after final subprocess exit; any content, inode, owner, mode, link-count or canonical-path drift blocks.

raw_once_materialization.raw_decode: Decode exactly 2000 unique validation logical event objects once, in the checkpoint/selection UID order, before any evaluator subprocess. Keep decoded objects only inside the materializer; never reopen raw sources after the materialization receipt fsync.
raw_once_materialization.teacher_batches: For batch ordinal 0..499, take consecutive decoded events [4b,4b+4), call the exact frozen collate_heterogeneous_events once, then exact frozen data_module.normalize_batch once. Persist every resulting tensor as an immutable teacher batch record. Exactly 500 batches, batch_size=4.
raw_once_materialization.rollout_singletons: For rollout ordinal 0..999, take decoded event at the same UID index, call collate_heterogeneous_events on a list of exactly one and normalize_batch separately. Persist every resulting tensor as an immutable singleton record. Do not slice teacher batch tensors as rollout inputs.
raw_once_materialization.tensor_record_rules: phase is teacher or rollout; ordinal is contiguous from zero; tensor keys are sorted by UTF-8 bytes; dtype is ASCII str(torch.dtype); shape is nonnegative integer array; tensor is detached contiguous CPU logical bytes in little-endian runtime; byte_length exactly equals payload length; hash is SHA-256 payload. One record per tensor key per phase/ordinal.
raw_once_materialization.immutability: Materialized payload files are fsynced, parent-fsynced, chmod read-only, rehashed, and never modified. All four subprocesses open only these tensors plus bound checkpoint/code/contract inputs; no raw source or normalizer call is allowed inside a block.

teacher_forward_plan.target_level_list: For each normalized teacher batch, compute sorted unique integer level_ids>0 under node_mask exactly as frozen validate_reconstruction. List must be nonempty and is persisted with the batch plan.
teacher_forward_plan.forward_identity: One and only one model forward for each ordered pair (teacher_batch_ordinal,positive_target_level), iterating batch ordinal 0..499 then that batch's target levels ascending. No repeated, omitted, singleton, reordered or diagnostic forward.
teacher_forward_plan.total_forward_count: teacher_target_level_total_count=sum over 500 target_level_list lengths; bind the integer and SHA-256 of canonical ordered pairs in materialization, batch plan, every block and final receipt.
teacher_forward_plan.per_event_statistics: For each produced batch-level/target-level output, slice produced pointer output, frozen matches, confidence targets and normalized tensors by event index 0..3. Compute per-event counts and total-loss contribution from those slices only. No second forward, no recollation, no renormalization and no singleton teacher evaluation.
teacher_forward_plan.ordered_batch_boundary_digest: Use v3 uint64-be batch ordinal/count and length-prefixed UID bytes over exactly 500 four-UID batches; bind it in every block.
teacher_forward_plan.warmup_signature: Teacher signature is the exact tuple(target_level_list). For each distinct signature choose its lowest measured batch ordinal; sort selected ordinals ascending. Warmup performs exactly the same one-forward-per-level loop on each selected immutable batch. Thus every selected signature is covered once and no signature/batch/level pair is duplicated.
teacher_forward_plan.rollout_warmup_signature: Rollout signature is (truth_max_level, leaf_multiplicity_bucket), with bucket low<=4, medium<=8, high>8 as frozen. Choose lowest rollout ordinal for each distinct signature and run the exact frozen teacher/predicted/bounded/scheduled rollout controls on each selected immutable singleton once. Bind selected ordinals/signatures and their digest before block one.

data_access_receipt.access_record: Canonical record exact keys role,event_ordinal,event_uid,source_locator,source_record_sha256; role literal validation; ordered digest uses canonical JSON records with LF.
data_access_receipt.physical_open_record: Canonical exact keys open_ordinal,absolute_path,st_dev,st_ino,byte_length,sha256,flags; flags literal O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW. Count is data-layout-dependent but fixed before block one and digest-bound.
data_access_receipt.block_enforcement: Seccomp/landlock or equivalently reviewed path-open mediation must make any raw, train, test, stress or unlisted-path open inside evaluator subprocess fatal and durably recorded.

numeric_receipt_contract.sigmoid_execution: For each produced batch/target-level confidence_logits, execute torch.sigmoid on the original device and frozen logits dtype exactly once. Do not pre-cast logits.
numeric_receipt_contract.comparison_execution: ECE bin comparisons and confidence-target subtraction/square use the original frozen probability/target tensor device and dtypes and the frozen interval rules [i/10,(i+1)/10), final upper inclusive. Do not pre-cast tensors.
numeric_receipt_contract.Brier_contribution: After frozen-dtype square, iterate the event slice in logical C-order, cast each scalar result to Python float/binary64, store event brier_sum=math.fsum(values) and exact element count.
numeric_receipt_contract.ECE_contribution: After frozen-dtype sigmoid/comparison, for each event and bin iterate selected probabilities and targets in logical C-order, cast each scalar to Python float/binary64, and store count, math.fsum(probabilities), math.fsum(targets).
numeric_receipt_contract.loss_contribution: Compute exact frozen sliced-event total loss from already-produced tensors for each positive target level. Cast each scalar loss to Python float/binary64 only after frozen computation; event loss_total_sum=math.fsum(contributions in ascending target-level order), count=list length.
numeric_receipt_contract.bootstrap: Repeated UID records repeat stored binary64 contributions. Floating aggregation uses math.fsum in matrix-column order; integer counts sum exactly; divide once. Brier/ECE/loss formulas and loss ratio boundary remain v3 exact.
numeric_receipt_contract.serialization: Finite Python binary64 values only, no -0.0; canonical allow_nan=false JSON numeric rendering. Receipt binds original dtype lists, numeric contract SHA, Python/Torch/CUDA/runtime hashes and statistic content SHA.
numeric_receipt_contract.mismatch: Any dtype-list, traversal-order, bin, count, cast stage, serialization or contract-hash mismatch blocks.

rollout_structural_contract_inline.record_types: event_uid nonempty string; event_index integer 0..999 equal array index; source_role literal validation; validation_train_fallback_used false; indicators strict booleans; all counts strict nonnegative JSON integers; source_jaccard_sum finite binary64.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.truth_edge: truth_edge_count is the sum of multiplicities in the canonical truth-edge Counter. It may be zero per UID. precision=common/predicted if predicted>0 else float(truth==0); recall=common/truth if truth>0 else float(predicted==0); F1=2PR/(P+R) if P+R>0 else 0.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.mother_type: Per UID correct/total if total>0 else 1.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.leaf_assignment: Per UID correct/total if total>0 else 1.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.source_overlap: Per UID source_jaccard_sum/source_jaccard_count if count>0 else 0.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.root_success: Boolean: truth root Counter nonempty and predicted/truth root Counters intersect.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.tree_valid: No diagonal edge, no directed cycle, and every predicted edge has mother level strictly greater than child level.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.reconstruction_valid: tree_valid, recursive_source_conflicts==0, every active predicted non-leaf has at least one active daughter, and every active predicted leaf has a nonempty recursive leaf-source set.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.leaf_retention: truth_leaf_source_count is cardinality of union of truth active-leaf source IDs; retained is intersection cardinality with predicted active-leaf source union.
rollout_structural_contract_inline.aggregation: All frozen rollout endpoints are math.fsum(per-UID value in UID order)/1000. Only complete_target_efficiency pools sum(correct)/sum(eligible).
rollout_structural_contract_inline.hard: Every UID tree_valid, reconstruction_valid, scheduled_rollout_valid and full leaf retention; recursive conflicts sum zero; teacher and predicted P4 closed counts equal positive composite counts; validation fallback count zero.

four_fresh_process_ABBA.parent: After materialization and before block one, the non-GPU parent sequentially reads every byte of every authorized immutable input and materialized tensor file in manifest order, verifies SHA/length, records page_touch_start/end_monotonic_ns and digest, fsyncs its receipt, then never opens GPU/CUDA.
four_fresh_process_ABBA.freshness: Each block is a newly execve'd evaluator subprocess with a new PID and fresh CUDA context. No Python interpreter, model object, CUDA allocation, module cache or process-local tensor survives between blocks.
identical_lifecycle: synchronize and reset CUDA peak stats
write/full-write/fsync all receipts and parent dirs
four_fresh_process_ABBA.parent_between_blocks: Wait for clean subprocess exit, verify durable block receipt and no surviving child/GPU process, then start next fresh subprocess; no page-touch refresh or scientific read between blocks.
four_fresh_process_ABBA.repeated_arm_identity: q32_A/q32_B and relbias_A/relbias_B must have identical teacher statistics SHA, rollout statistics SHA, dtype-contract SHA, model-state SHA, event/normalization/batch/UID/target-level hashes and causal input hashes. Timing, memory, PID, block identity and envelope hashes may differ.
four_fresh_process_ABBA.throughput: Block rate=3000/positive measured seconds. Arm rate=math.sqrt(first*second); require relbias/q32>=0.9.
four_fresh_process_ABBA.memory: Arm peak allocated/reserved is maximum across its blocks; each 0<allocated<=reserved<=device total.

future_synthetic_feasibility_gate.science_exclusion: Must not open, name, hash, derive from, or contain any terminal checkpoint bytes, event UID, raw/normalized event, label, target, validation selection, model endpoint, metric or outcome. It produces infrastructure timing/memory only.
future_synthetic_feasibility_gate.contract_inputs: Reviewed public/config-only upper bounds: checkpoint file byte-size ceiling; tensor-materialization byte-movement ceiling; 500 batch4 teacher schedule with maximum configured positive-level control count; 1000 singleton maximum-eight-level rollout/control schedule; receipt/serialization byte ceiling; exact runtime and resource closure.
future_synthetic_feasibility_gate.ABBA: Four fresh subprocesses control_A,control_B,control_B,control_A. Each independently reads a nonscientific synthetic file of checkpoint-size ceiling, allocates deterministic synthetic tensors at shape/byte ceilings, executes maximum control-flow and CUDA arithmetic schedule without a model or labels, writes/serializes/fsyncs ceiling-sized dummy receipts, frees, synchronizes and exits. Parent performs the same pre-first-block page-touch and between-process checks.
future_synthetic_feasibility_gate.byte_movement: Move at least the proposed recovery materialization ceiling bytes host-to-host and host-to-device in the same ordered chunk sizes; serialize and fsync at least the proposed maximum receipt bytes per block. Synthetic bytes come from a domain-separated counter pattern, not project data.
future_synthetic_feasibility_gate.headroom_rationale: Three-hour/48-GiB/80%-VRAM feasibility gates reserve at least one hour, 16 GiB host memory and 20% device memory beneath recovery contract ceilings.
future_synthetic_feasibility_gate.failure: Any missing receipt, nonzero subprocess, exceeded threshold or lifecycle/hash mismatch means the proposed recovery resources are infeasible. Amend resources and repeat independent review; never truncate UIDs, batches, target levels, rollouts, warmup, receipts, hashes or ABBA blocks.

primary_and_NI_inference: Unchanged from v3: two primary paired bootstrap endpoints, raw p_j(0), deterministic Holm step-down, correctly labeled Bonferroni simultaneous percentile bounds, delta>=0.01; every NI guard uses intersection-union raw one-sided p<=0.05 plus estimate strictly inside margin; complete-target test computed once and reused.
no_posthoc_substitute: No old aggregate, raw re-read, renormalization, changed batch size/boundary, second teacher forward, reused evaluator process/CUDA context, two-block replay, inferred timestamp, 15-second telemetry, synthetic feasibility result as scientific evidence, or truncated plan can satisfy recovery evidence.
